relationships.subject: spinal cord injury
relationships.evidence_quote: The expression of KCC2 protein was significantly decreased at 3, 7, 21, 35, and 56 dpi compared to the sham group, reaching the lowest level at 7 dpi

relationships.subject: spinal cord injury
relationships.evidence_quote: The NKCC1 protein was significantly increased at 7 dpi compared to the sham group

relationships.subject: CLP290 + bumetanide combination
relationships.evidence_quote: At both 21 and 56 dpi, the level of KCC2 in the combined treatment group showed the greatest increase in protein expression that was significantly different from that of the SCI + vehicle group

relationships.subject: bumetanide
relationships.evidence_quote: However, at 56 dpi, KCC2 protein in the SCI + bumetanide group showed significant difference compared to the SCI + vehicle group (p = 0.015)

relationships.subject: CLP290
relationships.evidence_quote: NKCC1 expression levels were significantly down regulated in the SCI + CLP290 and SCI + bumetanide groups compared with the SCI + vehicle group at 21dpi

relationships.subject: bumetanide
relationships.evidence_quote: NKCC1 expression levels were significantly down regulated in the SCI + CLP290 and SCI + bumetanide groups compared with the SCI + vehicle group at 21dpi

relationships.subject: CLP290 + bumetanide combination
relationships.evidence_quote: These data indicate that the combination of CLP290 and bumetanide maximizes in relieving mechanical allodynia than either drug used alone.

relationships.subject: CLP290 + bumetanide combination
relationships.evidence_quote: The combined treatment group exhibited the most significant improvement in restoring Rate-Dependent Depression (RDD) levels.

relationships.subject: CLP290
relationships.evidence_quote: CLP290 is a selective activator of KCC2, previously identified by Gagnon et al.

key_findings: After rat SCI, lumbar dorsal horn KCC2 falls and NKCC1 rises; CLP290, bumetanide and especially their combination raise the KCC2/NKCC1 ratio, restore H-reflex RDD and relieve mechanical, thermal and cold hypersensitivity.
Bumetanide gave long-term (56 dpi) benefit with KCC2 upregulation, whereas CLP290 mainly had short-term (21 dpi) effects.
